heading: 1.01.010 - Adoption.
text:
From and after June 20, 1967, the Clark County Code, prepared by Book Publishing Company,
codifiers, and approved and accepted, shall be the official code of all the ordinances
of a general and permanent character of the county of Clark, state of Nevada.

(Ord. 268 § 1, 1967)

heading: 1.01.020 - Amendments and supplements.
text:
There is adopted, as a method of perpetual codification, the loose-leaf type of binding
together with the continuous supplemental service whereby each newly adopted ordinance
of a general nature amending, altering, adding to, or deleting provisions of the Clark
County Code is identified by the proper title or catchline and, following preparation
by Book Publishing Company, is inserted in the proper place in each of the official
copies. Supplements to the Clark County Code of newly adopted ordinances amending,
altering, adding to, or deleting provisions thereof shall be furnished at least once
a year.

(Ord. 268 § 2, 1967)

heading: 1.01.030 - File.
text:
At least three official copies of the Clark County Code shall at all times be on file
and available for inspection by the general public at the office of the Clark County
clerk.

(Ord. 268 § 3, 1967)
